title: Cross-Platform Extract-and-Refresh SLA Scorecard
dataSources: All cat-24 sourcetypes summarised into a `bi_platform_summary` index via scheduled saved searches.
app: Cross-platform rollup built from the cat-24 sourcetypes already ingested (BI tools, orchestration, ELT, data quality, governance) via saved-search summary indexing.
spl:
index=bi_platform_summary metric="refresh_sla"
| stats sum(on_time) as on_time, sum(total) as total by platform
| eval sla_pct=round(100*on_time/total,1)
| sort sla_pct
description: Combines extract, dataset, reload and pipeline refresh outcomes from Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, dbt and orchestration into one on-time SLA percentage per platform.
value: Executives want one number for 'is our data on time?'; a cross-platform SLA scorecard replaces a dozen tool-specific dashboards.
implementation: Summarise refresh/pipeline outcomes into the rollup index; schedule daily and publish the scorecard to leadership.
visualization: Scorecard of platform by on-time SLA, trend line.

references.title: Splunk — Use summary indexing for increased search efficiency
Splunk — About the Common Information Model

grandmaExplanation: We turn all the different data-refresh checks into one simple on-time score for each tool.
